accounting.reason_pair_total_changes_under_conditio: each side's valid binomial outcome count is generated from its fixed attempts; total SOG is consequently random, not independently resplit or forced to an impossible pair total

kernel.attempts: held byte-for-byte at committed Phase 2A home/away attempt counts for each stored draw
kernel.baseline_probability: p_side = Phase 2A side SOG / side attempts for that same draw; zero attempts map to p=0

conditional_mean_quadrature_audit.quadrature: 32-point Gauss-Hermite, same nodes and weights as feasibility harness

kernel.continuity: conditional probabilities converge to Phase 2A side rates as sigma tends to zero; SOG counts remain bounded by attempts at every sigma
kernel.outcome_draw: SOG_side ~ Binomial(attempts_side, adjusted p_side), sampled by inverse CDF with common uniforms across sigma
kernel.probability_centering: 32-point Gauss-Hermite offsets; each side's marginal conversion probability remains its Phase 2A p
kernel.sigma_effect: mean-preserving Gaussian logit shifts of side conversion probability; one U per game-draw, +sigma*U home and -sigma*U away
kernel.zero_sigma: the conditional-binomial family limit, not exact Phase 2A SOG-trace identity; exact expected SOG count equals the Phase 2A count for every draw

limits: This is a count-level conditional kernel, not an event-stream or simulator replay.
The Phase 2A per-draw SOG/attempt ratio is a committed model-output rate, not a separately estimated pregame conversion probability.

A binomial conditional redraw adds outcome variation relative to the finite 16-draw Phase 2A trace; the sigma-zero point is not exact trace identity, though its expected counts match the trace exactly.
Because attempt splits are fixed, the preregistered attempt-margin-variance condition B cannot pass; the bootstrap interval is structurally [0,0].

The old invalid kernel's SOG CRPS uses only its SOG marginal predictions and labels. SOG>attempt violations do not enter that score directly; the corrected-kernel score difference is not a causal decomposition of the old +0.154630 penalty.
No event paths, locations, shooter identities, goals, special-teams outcomes, clocks, regulation, overtime, or shootouts are reconstructed.

protocol.bootstrap_unit: eligible game ID; both teams and all 16 stored draws stay together
protocol.common_random_numbers: each replicate regenerates the same shared normal and side-specific uniforms at every sigma
protocol.condition_a: per-replicate mean paired team-SOG CRPS delta <= 0
protocol.condition_b_as_written: attempt Var(H-A) >= 244.667 and paired 95% game-cluster interval for candidate-minus-Phase2A attempt Var(H-A) wholly above zero
protocol.crps: same discrete empirical-ensemble CRPS implementation as Phase 2A feasibility harness, previously cross-checked against Phase 2A _crps_discrete
protocol.degenerate_interval_predeclaration: a zero-width interval is undefined for the interval-only subcriterion and never a pass; B as a conjunction still fails if its point-variance threshold fails
protocol.sog_eligibility: the 1,292 accepted official-SOG games are used for both model CRPS and labels

results_by_sigma.kernel_point: conditional-binomial zero-sigma limit; not exact Phase 2A trace identity
